title: Travel policy: booking flights
content: Employees book all business flights through the Contoso Travel portal. Economy class is the default. Premium economy is allowed for flights longer than 6 hours. Business class requires written approval from a VP and is only permitted for flights longer than 10 hours. Bookings must be made at least 14 days in advance unless the trip is customer-critical.

title: Travel policy: hotels and per diem
content: Hotel stays are capped at 180 EUR per night in Europe, 250 USD per night in North America and 150 USD per night elsewhere. The daily meal per diem is 60 EUR in Europe and 75 USD in North America. Alcohol is not reimbursable. Keep itemised receipts for every expense above 25 EUR.

title: Expense claims
content: Submit expense claims in the Expenses app within 30 days of the purchase. Claims older than 90 days are rejected automatically. Your manager approves claims up to 2,000 EUR; anything higher also needs Finance approval. Reimbursements are paid with the next monthly payroll run.

title: Annual leave
content: Full-time employees receive 27 days of paid annual leave per calendar year plus public holidays. Up to 5 unused days can be carried over to the next year and must be used by 31 March. Leave requests of more than 10 consecutive working days need approval 4 weeks in advance.

title: Parental leave
content: Contoso offers 20 weeks of fully paid parental leave to all parents, regardless of gender, within the first 12 months after birth or adoption. Leave can be split into up to three blocks. A phased return of 4 weeks at 60% hours on full pay is available afterwards.

title: Laptops and devices
content: New joiners receive a Surface Laptop and can choose either a Surface Pro or an iPad as a secondary device. Devices are refreshed every 3 years. Lost or stolen devices must be reported to the IT Service Desk within 24 hours so they can be remotely wiped.

title: Security basics
content: Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for all accounts. Passwords are replaced by passkeys wherever supported. Never share customer data in personal chat apps. Report suspicious emails with the Report Phishing button in Outlook; the security team replies within one business day.

title: Hybrid and remote work
content: Contoso is hybrid by default: teams agree their own in-office days, with a recommendation of two per week. Employees may work fully remotely from another country for up to 30 days per year after notifying HR. A one-off home office allowance of 500 EUR covers a desk, chair or monitor.

title: Learning budget
content: Every employee has an annual learning budget of 1,500 EUR for courses, books, certifications and conferences. Microsoft certification exam fees are always covered and do not count against the budget. Unused budget does not roll over. Employees also get 5 learning days per year.

title: Wellbeing benefits
content: Contoso pays up to 50 EUR per month towards a gym or sports club membership. The Employee Assistance Programme offers free, confidential counselling 24/7 by phone or chat. Each employee can take 2 wellbeing days per year in addition to annual leave.
